description: Add a logout button to gear-ui-vue. Currently App.vue renders only <RouterView /> with no navigation wrapper. The authStore.logout() function exists in src/store/auth.ts (clears localStorage and redirects to /login) but nothing calls it from the UI. Fix: update App.vue on the VPS to add a conditional nav header that shows on all authenticated routes (route.name !== 'login') with a logout button that calls authStore.logout(). Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: Read current App.vue on VPS via server-manager::exec: `cat /root/projects/gear-ui-vue/src/App.vue` to confirm current content.

Write the new App.vue to VPS via server-manager::exec using a heredoc or tee command. The new content must: (a) import `useRoute` from `vue-router` and `useAuthStore` from `@/store/auth`; (b) compute `const isLoginPage = computed(() => route.name === 'login')`; (c) render a `<nav v-if='!isLoginPage'>` header above `<RouterView />` containing a site title and a logout button that calls `authStore.logout()`; (d) style the nav with a dark header (#1a1a1a bg, white text) and a logout button with `.btn` class and inline secondary styling.
Write the file: use server-manager::exec on aerentix-vps with a command that writes the complete file content using `tee /root/projects/gear-ui-vue/src/App.vue`.
On VPS: `cd /root/projects && docker compose build --no-cache gear-ui && docker compose up -d --force-recreate gear-ui`
Verify: `docker ps | grep gear-ui` shows Up; `docker logs gear-ui 2>&1 | tail -5` shows no errors.
acceptance_criteria: On VPS: `docker ps | grep gear-ui` shows container status Up
On VPS: `docker logs gear-ui 2>&1 | tail -5` shows no build/serve errors
Navigating to http://103.118.175.235:30003/secrets (after login) shows a navbar with a Logout button
The /login page does NOT show the navbar/logout button
Clicking Logout redirects to /login and clears the session
verification: On VPS (server-manager::exec aerentix-vps): docker ps | grep gear-ui
On VPS: docker logs gear-ui 2>&1 | tail -5
On VPS: curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -i logout (should find the logout button in served HTML or confirm container responds)
findings: App.vue updated on VPS with conditional nav header (dark #1a1a1a bg, white text, site title 'Gear Engine', Logout button). Nav hides on login page via isLoginPage computed (route.name === 'login'). Logout button calls authStore.logout(). gear-ui rebuilt with --no-cache and restarted. Container confirmed Up with nginx worker processes running (no errors).
